what.text: This page follows refugees from Cameroon in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 140366 refugees from Cameroon.
Nigeria hosts the largest share, 76.7%, followed by Chad, the United States and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Ambazonia territory in Cameroon from 2017 to 2025, with Ambazonia insurgents.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Cameroon with JAS in 2020 and from 2022 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group in several years from 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1989 at 60 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 147352, at the end of 2022, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025.
The data shows large changes between 2017 and 2018 and between 2020 and 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country; people displaced inside Cameroon are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC.
